def myLen : List α → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | _ :: xs => myLen xs + 1

theorem myLen_replicate (n : Nat) (a : α) : myLen (List.replicate n a) = n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    simp_all [List.replicate_succ, List.cons_length]

def myLen : List α → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | _ :: xs => myLen xs + 1

theorem myLen_replicate (n : Nat) (a : α) : myLen (List.replicate n a) = n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp_all [List.map_append, List.nil_length]
    <;> linarith

  | _ :: xs => myLen xs + 1

theorem myLen_replicate (n : Nat) (a : α) : myLen (List.replicate n a) = n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp_all only [List.cons, List.nil, myLen_cons]
    <;> rw [List.len_map] at *
    <;> simp_all

def myLen : List α → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | _ :: xs => myLen xs + 1

theorem myLen_replicate (n : Nat) (a : α) : myLen (List.replicate n a) = n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    unfold myLen
    <;> simp [List.replicate_succ] at *
    <;> rw [ih]
    <;> simp
